title: Surface gravitational acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final expression for gravitational acceleration on Mars: g = v²/(2h).

title: Mass of Mars
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final expression for the mass of Mars: M = v²R²/(2Gh).

title: Density of Mars
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the final expression for the density of Mars: ρ = 3v²/(8πGhR).

title: Use of kinematic equation
description: Important: Applies the constant acceleration kinematic equation (v² = u² + 2gh) correctly, recognizing u=0 and g is constant near the surface.

title: Application of Newton's Law
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation (g = GM/R²) to relate surface gravity to planetary mass.

title: Density derivation
description: Important: Correctly uses the definition of density (ρ = M/V) with the volume of a sphere (V = 4πR³/3).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows awareness of unit dimensions or performs a unit analysis for the final expressions.

title: Sign or constant error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in kinematic equations, misplaces constants (like π or factors of 2/3), or confuses radius/diameter.

title: Incorrect g assumption
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes Earth's g or treats g as variable over the small drop height h.
